children: BILL changed its accounting presentation of BILL Spend and Expense card rewards, reclassifying rewards from sales and marketing expense to a reduction of interchange revenue effective July 1, 2026.
Effective July 1, 2026, rewards paid to spending businesses are now netted against subscription and transaction fees.
Previously classified as sales and marketing expense; now presented as a reduction of interchange revenue within subscription and transaction fees.
Change is retrospective beginning with quarter ended Sept 30, 2026; eight prior quarters' supplemental unaudited adjustments provided as Exhibit 99.1.
Company says change better reflects economic substance, aligns with internal reporting and industry practice for comparability.
Change does not affect operating income, net income/(loss), EPS, balance sheet, or cash flows for any period presented.
